mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS rising >0.5% over 3 months, or Rank IC >0.05 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 5% signals robust demand growth, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20d returns (p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 exceeding 5% in >50% of triggered instances, or 20d returns are negative in >60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 and HOUST above 5% monthly thresholds signals robust demand across sectors, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST rise >5% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 5d returns (p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and HOUST exceeding 5% in >50% of triggered instances, or 5d returns are negative in >60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a monthly UNRATE below 4.5% signals weakening labor market pressures, reducing inflationary expectations and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20d returns (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 4.5% in >50% of triggered instances, or 20d returns are negative in >60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise in the same month
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant negative 20d returns (p > 0.05) despite both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rising in >50% of triggered instances, or 20d returns are positive in >60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO exceeding 110 signals robust supply growth, reducing inflationary pressures and boosting investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 5d returns (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO exceeding 110 in >50% of triggered instances, or 5d returns are negative in >60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession recovery regime, a monthly UNRATE below 4.0% signals improving labor market conditions, reducing deflationary pressures and boosting equity values, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20d returns (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 4.0% in >50% of triggered instances, or 20d returns are negative in >60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both PAYEMS (unemployment) and UNRATE (wage growth) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer demand and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both PAYEMS and UNRATE rise in the same month
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20d returns (p > 0.05) despite both PAYEMS and UNRATE rising in >50% of triggered instances, or 20d returns are negative in >60% of such events.
